prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a slow walk along a dimly lit path bordered by a chain-link fence, moving steadily forward under a heavy rain shower. The camera pans slightly to the right, revealing more of the fence and the dark, wet ground reflecting faint light. As the viewer progresses, the path opens up into a broader street lined with vintage-style street lamps casting a soft glow through the misty night air. The camera continues straight ahead, capturing the rhythmic motion of footsteps on the wet pavement. The surrounding environment is shrouded in darkness, with occasional trees and lampposts emerging from the fog. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive view of the empty urban landscape. The street curves gently to the left, leading towards a crosswalk marked with white stripes. The rain continues to fall steadily, creating a consistent pattern of droplets on the camera lens. The overall atmosphere is quiet and desolate, with no other people or vehicles in sight. The muted colors of the night, combined with the soft illumination from the street lamps, create a serene yet somber ambiance as the viewer navigates through East Maddon Park, London, under the cover of a rainy night.
